author: Grok
status: NUMBERS ONLY — Claude applies; do not confuse with live index.html until merged

cg_context.source: Bone Crush CG Basic Launch rejection (same three KPIs)
cg_context.conversion_def: % of players still playing after 60 seconds

squadMax.rationale: Live index.html CFG.squadMax is 300 (army feel + meta shop stacks). 100 is the original soft-army design (STATUS doc). 1100 appears only as pass drift and must NOT be used — it flattens column pressure math and makes L1-2 feel empty rather than fair. Eric can override; curve below is built on 300.

alternatives_rejected.100: meta Start-Squad shop can't show meaningful growth; feels tiny on vertical canvas
alternatives_rejected.1100: experimental drift; kills readability and confuses gate +/– feedback

current_live.problem: L1 minus gates can delete a 5–9 unit starter squad in one touch → harness/new-player death on L1. That is the conversion killer, not raw spawnRate.

changes: startingSquad floor 10 (was 5) — survives contact + one soft minus gate
L1–2 spawnRate 2/3 (was 3/4) + slower ramp (28s to full vs 20s)
L1 minus gates [-4,-1] not [-15,-6] — never deletes the run in second 15
mixEld/mixCyb zeroed on L1 — only fodder for the first minute
EKIND[0].hp = 1 — new player gets kill feedback immediately
conversion_60s.first_real_death: L3–L4 (boss or stacked minus+eld), not L1

playtime_10min.estimate_live_full_10_levels_min: 14–22 with shops (waveSec sum ~875s combat + shop 12–25s each)

endless.change: After campaign clear, auto-offer Endless with +1 Start Squad credit and a 'one more loop' banner — session extender, not a stall
endless.stall_fix: If endless loop 1 TTK of near-band exceeds 90s without perk agency, cut spawn mult to 1.05**k

playtime_10min.if_run_under_10min: Raise BAL.waveSec L1–6 by +8s each and ensure shop cannot be fully skipped without a 3s confirm (prevents speedrun bounce that tanks median)

retention_d1.shop_meta_verdict: Start Squad / Weapon / Armor meta is a real return hook IF a run earns >=1 meaningful upgrade. Soft L1–2 guarantees first-session credit income.

daily_login_bonus.day_2: +1 weapon tier next run (cap 1 free tier)
daily_login_bonus.day_3: rare perk ticket (pick 1 of 3, expires end of day)

retention_d1.ftue: Cold-open into play (skip heavy menu). First death offers 'try L1 again with +5 squad' once — conversion safety net without teaching bad habits forever.

headless_expect.before: node _headless_harness.js dies on L1 (minus gates / thin squad)
headless_expect.after_apply: bot should reach at least L3; first death modal around L3–4; full clear possible with auto-perk picks

apply_notes_for_claude: Only edit index.html (and mirror _game_extract.js if harness uses it) — Grok did not touch either.
Do not resubmit as a 'patch' of a rejected title; ship as NEW game listing when ready.
